question_or_proposition: During Federal FY2025, does footnote (*11) establish that the Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase limits in the nominated row (30-day average loading of 24,992 lbs/day and 30-day average concentration of 449 mg/L) are the applicable enforceable numeric discharge limits for relevant monitoring periods, as distinguished from the (*10) row limits and from the daily maximum columns designated 'Report'?
required_context: temporal applicability of footnote (*11) relative to Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30)
temporal applicability of footnote (*10) and the transition at three years from the permit effective date
footnote (*8) method for calculating net total dissolved solids
notes: The nominated row is the (*11)-period TDS Net Increase limit set; resolving its temporal applicability and which columns carry enforceable numeric limits determines which discharge limits apply in FY2025 and how missing or no-result monitoring evidence should be classified.
